What is each variable?

```{r}

lcfs_variables <- read.xlsx("C:/Users/DavidHawkey/Data/Living cost and food survey/LCF 2022-23/UKDA-9335-stata/mrdoc/excel/9335_volume_f_derived_variables_2022-23.xlsx", rows = 8:2832, cols = 1:5, colNames = F, sheet = "Part 2") %>% 
  tibble()

names(lcfs_variables) <- c("variable", "description", "table", "coding_frame", "inUKDA")

```

```{r}

transport_codes <- str_split(
  # string = "B244 + B245 + B247 + B249 + B250 + B252 + B248 + B218 + B217 +B219 + B216 + C71112 + C71122 + C71212 + C71311 + C71411 + C72111 + C72112 + C72113 + C72114 + C72115 + C72211 + C72212 + C72213 + C72313 + C72314 + C72411 + C72412 + C72413 + C72414 + C73112 + C73212 + C73213 + C73214 + C73311 + C73312 + C73411 + C73512 + C73513 + C73611",
  # string = "B244 + B245 + B247 + B249 + B250 + B252 + B248 + B218 + B217 +B219 + B216 + B487 + B488 + C71111c + C71112t + C71121c + C71122t + C71211c + C71212t +C71311t + C71411t + C72111t + C72112t + C72113t + C72114t + C72115t +C72211t + C72212t + C72213t + C72311c + C72312c + C72313t + C72314t + C72411t + C72412t + C72413t + C72414t + C73112t + C73212t + C73213t + C73214t + C73411t + C73512t + C73513t + C73611t",
  pattern = " *\\+ *"
) %>% unlist()

lcfs_variables %>% filter(tolower(variable) %in% tolower(transport_codes))

```

```{r}

rpi_codes_adult <- str_split(
  string = "71112, 92114, 71122, 92116, 71212, 72112, 72111, 91112, 72113, 31315, 72211, 72212, 72213, 72313, 72114, 72411, 72412, 72413, 72314, K3112",
  pattern = ", "
) %>% 
  unlist()
rpi_codes_adult <- paste0("c", rpi_codes_adult)

rpi_codes_children <- str_split(
  string = "71111, 92113, 71121, 92115, 71211, 72211, 72212, 72213, 72313, 72413, 72114, 72411, 72412, 72111, 72314, K3112, 72311, 72113, 91112, 72312, 72113, 31315, C5411",
  pattern = ", "
) %>% 
  unlist()
rpi_codes_children <- paste0("c", rpi_codes_children, "c")

lcfs_variables %>% filter(tolower(variable) %in% rpi_codes_adult) %>% clipr::write_clip()
lcfs_variables %>% filter(tolower(variable) %in% rpi_codes_children) %>% clipr::write_clip()
```


```{r}

adult_fares <- "92111, 92117, 92311, C5412,71311,71411, 72115, 73112, 73212, 73512, 73311, 73312, 73411, 73513, 73213, 72414, 73214, 73611"
child_fares <- "92111, 92117, 92311, C5412, 71311, 72115, 71411, 73112, 73212, 73512, 73311, 73312, 73411, 73513, 73213, 72414, 73214, 73611"

adult_fare_codes <- str_split(
  string = adult_fares %>% gsub(" ", "", .),
  pattern = ","
) %>% unlist()

child_fare_codes <- str_split(
  string = child_fares %>% gsub(" ", "", .),
  pattern = ","
) %>% unlist()

total_fare_codes <- paste0("c", unique(c(adult_fare_codes, child_fare_codes)), "t")
adult_fare_codes <- paste0("c", adult_fare_codes)
child_fare_codes <- paste0("c", child_fare_codes, "c")

lcfs_variables %>% filter(tolower(variable) %in% total_fare_codes) %>% clipr::write_clip()
lcfs_variables %>% filter(tolower(variable) %in% adult_fare_codes) %>% clipr::write_clip()
lcfs_variables %>% filter(tolower(variable) %in% child_fare_codes) %>% clipr::write_clip()

```
